profiles.identityBoundary: Natural evidence profile; does not identify any uploaded pigeon GLB as Columba livia

numericStudyEnvelope.source: Berg and Biewener 2008 captive carrier-pigeon sample; use as R0 study envelope, not universal species constants
takeoffLandingPrinciples: takeoff uses greater wingbeat frequency and downstroke amplitude than level flight
legs contribute strongly at launch while wings provide subsequent acceleration
landing deceleration occurs mostly before foot contact

movement: stable commuting routes from colony/roost to feeding sites
predatorRisk: escape-takeoff state must be distinct from routine departure
flock cohesion/alarm signal interface required but exact predator list remains habitat-specific

urban birds used urban surfaces and water more; rural birds mainly agricultural areas
individual site/habitat fidelity must be represented

searchModes: walking quickly/activity level varies by species
foodOrPrey: aquatic/terrestrial invertebrates depending species and habitat

crossProfileRules: Do not assign a natural ecology profile from file title alone
